Population increased in Harrow

The estimated population of Harrow in 2024 was 270,724 usual residents, a rise of 1.4% since 2023.

This meant that Harrow's rate of population change placed it about average among local authority districts in England and Wales.

In the period from mid-2021 to mid-2024, the population estimate of Harrow increased by 3.7%.

Over this slightly longer period, Harrow was also among the areas that had a broadly average population increase, of local authority districts in England and Wales.

Age profile of Harrow

The average (median) age fell to 37.8 years between 2023 and 2024.

You can see how the age profile of Harrow has changed since 2011 in the population pyramid below.

sections.content:
Harrow is an area that is classed as urban in nature according to the 2021 Census Rural Urban Classification.

By age category, Harrow's population of 270,724 usual residents was made up of:

  • 53,449 people aged 0 to 15 years, (19.7%)
  • 174,688 people aged 16 to 64 years, (64.5%)
  • 42,587 people aged 65 years and over, (15.7%)

    • Compared with England and Wales as a whole, Harrow has a slightly lower proportion of people aged 65 years and over (15.7% compared with 18.9% for England and Wales).

Contributors to population change

We look at different flows of people into and out of areas and births and deaths to see what is driving population change in each area.

In Harrow, the largest contribution to population change in the year to mid-2024 was from net international migration.

sections.title: Contributors to population change in Harrow
sections.subtitle: How the population changed, by component

sections.content:
We estimate that, for Harrow, between 2023 and 2024:

  • More births than deaths increased the population of 1,399 people (0.5%). In total, there were 3,115 births and 1,716 deaths in Harrow.
  • Net internal migration (people moving to and from other areas in the UK) led to a fall in the population of 4,642 (-1.7%). There were 20,995 people entering the area and 25,637 people leaving the area.
  • Net international migration led to an increase in Harrow's population of 7,094 (2.7%) as a result of 10,700 people entering the area and 3,606 people leaving the area.
  • Other change (which includes changes to armed forces personnel and prisoners) for Harrow was less than 0.1%.

Revisions to 2023 population estimates

We regularly revise our initial population estimates as we get more data and methods improve.

Our revised estimate for the population of Harrow in mid-2023 is 266,891.

Within this, international migration was revised upwards by 3,865 people and internal migration estimates were revised downwards by 422 people.

Overall, there was an revision upwards of 3,443 people.
